comment: Expected native files and models of a Release bundle. Roles: panel-ocr and capture libraries are bound by a <path>.sha256 sidecar (panel-ocr-binding, capture-binding) that must hold the library sha256. vision and model files must be listed in data/vision/runtime.manifest.json. vcruntime files carry the committed minimum PE file version (design D7: 14.33, the newest toolset that linked a bundled third-party DLL - leptonica-1.82.0.dll links 14.33, tesseract50.dll 14.29 - and within the VS 2022 14.3x floor). Any other .dll or .traineddata under the bundle is unexpected.
